summary.plain: Bare germanium crystals submerged directly in a huge tank of ultra-cold liquid argon, deep under an Italian mountain, listening for a rare kind of radioactive decay.
summary.technical: Array of bare, enriched (76Ge) high-purity germanium point-contact detectors (~40 kg total) submerged directly in a 64 m3 liquid-argon cryostat that serves as both cooling medium and active veto, in LNGS Hall A.

technology.quote: operating Ge detectors made from 76Ge enriched material in a 64 m3 liquid argon cryostat
technology.value: Bare enriched-germanium point-contact detectors immersed in a liquid-argon cryostat
